title: Journey Regression Suite Manifest
description: Manifest produced by the journey-tests generator. Records emitted spec files, node coverage, and overall pass/fail status for G6 regression verification.

suite_id.description: Stable identifier for this regression suite run.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the suite was generated.

journeys.description: One entry per journey covered by this suite.

spec_path.description: Relative path to the emitted spec file.

surface_types.description: Surface types present in this journey's steps.

node_tags.description: Every step node id covered by emitted test blocks in spec_path.

actors.description: Distinct actor ids present in this journey's steps (populated for cross-actor journeys; omitted for single-actor journeys).

total_nodes.description: Total journey-step node ids in the ecosystem.

covered_nodes.description: Node ids that appear in at least one emitted test block.

orphan_nodes.description: Node ids that appear in the ecosystem but have no emitted test block.

status.description: pass when coverage.orphan_nodes is empty; fail otherwise.
